next_action.description: Do the mono A/B on the phasing first - it is read-only and needs no graph edit. Take the best bench output from G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI\temp\*-audio.mp4, render a mono collapse with ./node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe, and have Fabio A/B it: phasing gone means the HF-weighted L/R divergence is the cause, phasing remaining means it is in the mono content. key_decisions: Item 3 stopped on Fabio's call and he was right: reference audio would add a SECOND media slot (audio) to foley's inputSchema, so building the step-0-thumbnail + big-preview middle step against today's one-slot input set means rebuilding it. UI waits on the bench.

The audio-normaliser detour was a WRONG CALL, fully reverted. LTX2AudioLatentNormalizingSampling (KJNodes) is a MODEL patch whose wrapper assumes standard LTX2 joint AV sampling - foley freezes video and masks audio, so it threw 'mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (548736x1 and 128x3)'. LTXVNormalizingSampler (the node Fabio named) is the right layer but at its default 1,1,0.25,1,1,0.25,1,1 it DESTROYED the audio. #39 is back to SamplerCustomAdvanced, verified from /history across three runs.

Three audio problems were conflated all session and are now separated: 'underwater' = WIND RUMBLE, seed-dependent (sub-200 Hz equals full-mix level on bad seeds, 30 dB lower on a good one); loudness/clipping = PROMPT+SEED variance (~2 dB), not gain structure; phasing = HF-weighted L/R divergence on near-mono audio (MID -36.4 / SIDE -66.5, SIDE sloping -91 -> -62 dB with frequency).

Reference/voice-ID (#122=true) is probably a dead end at 8 steps - docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md records it as DROPPED for v1 on distilled because identity needs ~30 steps. Do not burn runs on it before the mono test and #108.
constraints: The seed lottery is WIDE - 35 dB swing in top-band content between seeds on one graph. One good run is not a result. audio-input.md already says 'seed is a LOTTERY - seed-hunt always'.
Fabio drives the bench UI and edits widgets himself. ALWAYS ask before writing to the bench file, and wait for him to save and close the tab first - he asked for this explicitly.
Bench file is G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI\user\default\workflows\flow_ltx_foley_AUDIO_bench.json. comfy_workflows/ in the repo is UNTOUCHED and must stay that way until the bench settles.

Measurement recipe that worked: ffmpeg at ./node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe with volumedetect, band splits (lowpass=200 rumble / lowpass=4000 / highpass=8000) and a mid-side pan. The rumble-vs-top-band ratio predicted Fabio's ear verdict on EVERY run, so seeds can be screened numerically. ebur128 is useless under ~10s.
